name: Kana Kara -Shizukana Kanojo Kara no Muriyari Gouin na H Kankei-
original_name: かなから　－静かな彼女からのムリヤリ強引なＨ関係－
source:
There is a paragon student Aoi who is always serious and quiet. Main character can't even hold her hands, but for he is captivated by the girl. But one day he sees her in unusual state. What is she doing?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-december-2007-dies-irae.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
御園葵是一名品學兼優的模範生，平日總是嚴肅而安靜。主角甚至連她的手都不敢牽，卻早已被這個女孩深深吸引。可有一天，他撞見了葵不同尋常的一面。她究竟在做什麼？
